name: Entity Fields Search
description: Entity Fields Search Based on Entity Type
project_description: Entity Fields Search (entitytype_filter) adds two admin utility pages for inspecting the configurable fields attached to bundle config entity types (content types, block types, paragraph types, media types, ECK types, and any add-on that defines a bundle config entity). One page searches the fields of a single named bundle by entity title with an autocomplete lookup; the other lists fields across all bundles of a chosen entity type, optionally narrowed to one field type, with a client-side CSV export. It relies only on Drupal core services (entity type manager, entity field manager, field type plugin manager) and defines no config, no permissions of its own, and no content model. It is aimed at site builders and developers who need to see field configuration across bundles without clicking through many Field UI pages.
